verdict.rationale: dlt is primarily an EL(T) tool for extracting from APIs/DBs into warehouses/lakehouses, but its docs explicitly mention a custom-destination interface for building reverse ETL pipelines (dlt-docs-3), which is directly on-topic for this story. However, no evidence shows pre-built or verified destinations for CRM/ads/support SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Ads) — the reverse-ETL support is only asserted generically via 'add a custom destination', not demonstrated with named SaaS activation connectors or community confirmation. Missing for 10: named SaaS/CRM/ads destination connectors, a documented reverse-ETL tutorial/example, and independent evidence of teams actually activating warehouse data into SaaS tools with dlt.
